name: Arkwell SEO Connector
author: arkwellagency

sections.description:
Arkwell SEO Connector connects a WordPress website to Arkwell SEO.

You must have an active Arkwell SEO subscription to connect your website. Please contact info@arkwellagency.com to join today for free.

The plugin can be configured to support:

  • Publishing blog posts from Arkwell SEO.
  • Uploading featured images into the WordPress Media Library.
  • Capturing selected lead notification emails sent through WordPress mail.
  • Syncing public site files such as llms.txt and sitemaps when enabled.
  • Sending post update events to Arkwell SEO when enabled.
  • Syncing recent and changed blog records to Arkwell SEO when enabled.

All remote communication is outbound from WordPress to Arkwell SEO over HTTPS. The plugin does not expose a public inbound WordPress REST endpoint.

Third-party service disclosure

This plugin connects to Arkwell SEO, a service operated by Arkwell Agency.

When the relevant options are enabled, the plugin may send the following data to Arkwell SEO:

  • Site ID and authentication signature.
  • Blog publishing job results.
  • Blog post title, slug, excerpt, content, URL, status, and related metadata.
  • Featured image import results.
  • Selected outgoing lead notification email data, including recipient, subject, message body, headers, source page, user agent, and IP address.
  • Public llms.txt and sitemap XML contents.
  • Post update before/after data.

This data is sent to provide the connected Arkwell SEO services selected by the site administrator.

Arkwell SEO website: https://arkwell.net/

Privacy policy: https://arkwell.net/app-privacy-policy/

Terms: https://arkwell.net/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/arkwell-connector directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Arkwell SEO Connector.
  4. Enter your Arkwell SEO URL, Site ID, and API Key.
  5. Enable only the features you want to use.
  6. Save settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Arkwell SEO subscription?

Yes. You must have an active Arkwell SEO subscription to connect your website. Please contact info@arkwellagency.com to join today for free.

Does this plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. This plugin sends selected data to Arkwell SEO when configured features are enabled. See the Third-party service disclosure section for details.

Does this plugin expose an inbound WordPress REST API endpoint?

No. The plugin uses outbound requests from WordPress to Arkwell SEO.

Can I turn features off?

Yes. Publishing polling, daily data sync, lead tracking, post update tracking, and blog status sync can be enabled or disabled from the plugin settings page.

Does lead tracking capture every outgoing email?

No. Lead tracking must be enabled. You can limit tracking to allowed recipient email addresses, and you can enable the built-in ignore list for common system emails.
